Excel is input only.","CP-OS":"Orchestrates selected analysis, current handoffs, bounded retries/cost, resume and verified delivery.","CP-2D":"Builds the near-term liquidity bridge and cash runway.","CP-3D":"Assesses market-implied credit risk and trading technicals.","CP-3C":"Assesses refinancing and liability-management risk before or during distress."},"sources":{"disclosure":"449e28443aebc42a7f5a2a323ca5dea1d4c34a2407531b9caaff47dcd3cac4d8","selected-method":"9e1a16330a06e98cd22ef7aa97be526c131d962ec3d3ff1ef9a3e42ca9bb311c","method-steps":"1483f4fe9e37d593bdf0cab58ac8eb0674aaa22745579bd9430380c57e763e97","offline-helper":"132dd9f24fbc62a5cacf4b40141779674c142f8cbcb3bb7d4a23e273c72fcf57"},"handoffs":{"CP-0":{"sha256":"166c1395182a3ed574ac6ef1be9050489b2a8f4cd9faf13a1a3cfc6172695a9d","markdown":"# CP-0 — Frontier dated restructuring-source admission

## Request

Admit an actual historical source for a positive CP-4C numerical function,
following `instructions.md`. Frontier Communications Corporation et al.; dated
June 29, 2020 solicitation disclosure statement for the third amended joint plan.
Analysis 2026-11-04, current host model with context; Ready with Limitations.

## Sources

[SEC Exhibit 99.1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/20520/000114036120015359/ex99_1.htm),
admitted as selected indexed text in `sources/source-lines.txt`, exact public
tool responses in `sources/web-captures.json`. Complete selected ranges are
L0–100, L5921–6344 and L6830–6923; additional captured gate/consent/plan passages
are retained at their original indexes. All 1,456 captured indexes are present
without unresolved overlap disagreement. This is not the whole 6,924-line
document, original HTML bytes, a reviewed entity-chart image or a court record
of realized recoveries. Source acquisition/preflight preceded the instruction lock.

## Findings

| Check | Evidence and dependent scope |
|---|---|
| Identity/version | L6 solicitation version, L20–34 Frontier and debtor affiliates, third amended plan; L48 dated June 29, 2020. It is not a final confirmed/emerged version. |
| Real distress/venue | L8–27 SDNY Chapter 11, case 20-22476 (RDD); L459 and L953 describe April 14, 2020 petition/RSA. Trigger is an actual filing, not a low bond price. |
| Claims and priority | Exhibit D L5988–5998 states modeled ordering and entity-by-entity aggregation. Low/high tables L6055–6237 have source-specific estimated claims, cash proceeds, allocations and deficiencies. B12–15 L6324/6332/6334/6336 describe shortfalls asserted pari passu at HoldCo. These are source assumptions, not independently adjudicated priority. |
| Liquidation timeline/value | L5977–5984 assumes sale close October 31 and liquidation November 1, 2020. A1–A7 and B1–B17 explain valuation, fees, claims and limitations. Actual realization/claim allowance is not asserted. |
| Plan value/time | Exhibit F L6844–6859 uses assumed January 1, 2021 emergence; EV range 10.00–12.50 USDbn, midpoint 11.25; net debt 6.56 and tax-affected pension/OPEB 1.37 USDbn imply 2.07–4.57 USDbn equity. It is a different case from liquidation. |
| Warning | L5938–5945: preliminary estimates, not audited/appraised, material uncertainty and no liquidation tax estimate. L6845–6846: plan value is not predicted trading value. |

## Calculations

No recovery arithmetic at this gate. Source claims and scenario value operands
are sufficient to test the selected pool allocation and recovery arithmetic;
they are not an independently validated complete underwriting pack.

## Gaps

Full source/image/legal-entity review, allowed claims and original instruments,
final amended/confirmed plan, actual distributions, raw bytes, independent
valuation, actual path likelihood and contemporary market/portfolio inputs.
No CP-1/2G/4 accepted native heads are manufactured to bypass those contracts.

## Next module

CP-4C should calculate the source-defined pledged-pool rank allocation and
HoldCo deficiency payouts, preserve case/date/basis and independently check the
plan equity bridge. Downstream CP-3A must consume the result without promoting
modeled liquidation cash to an actual payment or trade recommendation.

tools.description: Use the existing Decimal-38 kernel. Sum signed operands, or divide two operands. Values are decimal strings or null for missing; ratios are fractions, not percentages.
